newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CNPC (HK) surges on smaller interim loss.
newsitem.headline: CNPC (HK) surges on smaller interim loss.

text.p: Shares of oil explorer CNPC (Hong Kong) Ltd surged HK$0.05 or 13.89 percent to hit a new 52-week high of HK$0.41 in late trade on Tuesday after it reported a smaller loss in its interim results, brokers said.
"Speculation that the company earnings would show an upturn in wake of an improvement in the interim results fueled demand by speculators," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
"Anticipation that its oilfield projects would begin contributing to profit soon also boosted buying," he added.
